dnova-copilot.config.title: DNova Copilot
dnova-copilot.config.baseUrl.description: DNova API base URL. Defaults to the official DNova API endpoint.
dnova-copilot.config.maxTokens.descripti: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default (no limit). Useful for controlling costs.
dnova-copilot.config.debugMode.descripti:
Controls what diagnostic information DNova Copilot writes. Token usage is always reported to Copilot regardless of this setting.

- **Minimal** — Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or request dumps.
- **Metadata** — Privacy-safe diagnostic metadata (request hashes, prefix overlap, tool schema changes). Does not contain prompt text. View with [`DNova: Show Logs`](command:dnova-copilot.showLogs).
- **Verbose** — Complete request payloads written to disk for local debugging. **Warning: contains sensitive prompt content.** View with [`DNova: Open Request Dumps Folder`](command:dnova-copilot.openRequestDumpsFolder).
dnova-copilot.config.debugMode.minimal.d: Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or dumps.
Privacy-safe metadata. Safe to share publicly. View with `DNova: Show Logs`.
dnova-copilot.config.debugMode.verbose.d: ⚠️ Contains sensitive prompt content. For local debugging only.
dnova-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides.de: Override the API model ID sent for the DNova model. Default is prefilled with GLM-5.2; change only when using a compatible third-party API that uses different model names.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.enabled: Enable the bundled ABAP ADT MCP server. When enabled, ABAP ADT tools are available in Copilot Chat.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.httpEna: Enable the local Streamable HTTP MCP server. When disabled, the ABAP ADT MCP is unavailable; it does not fall back to stdio.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.httpHos: Local interface for the HTTP MCP server. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless another local interface is required.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.httpPor: Local TCP port for the HTTP MCP server.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.startup: Show a notification shortly after startup that verifies the ABAP ADT MCP can connect to SAP (success or failure).
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.exposit: Underlying core handler set used by the HTTP facade. Options: readonly, readonly,high, readonly,low, high, low, compact.
dnova-copilot.config.abap.agentGuide.aut: When an ABAP workspace is detected (files like .abap, .cds, .ddls, .clas), automatically create/update an AGENTS.md that instructs Copilot agents to prefer the bundled dnova-abap-mcp MCP server for ABAP tasks.
dnova-copilot.config.abap.agentGuide.fil: File (relative to the workspace root) used for the ABAP agent guide that teaches Copilot agents to prefer the bundled dnova-abap-mcp MCP server.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.url.des: SAP system URL for the ABAP ADT MCP server (basic auth), e.g. https://my-sap-system.example.com:8000
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.passwor: SAP password for basic authentication. Enable `dnova-copilot.mcp.abapAdt.useSecretStorage` and run the [`DNova: Set ABAP ADT MCP Password`](command:dnova-copilot.setAbapAdtPassword) command to store the password in the OS keychain instead.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.useSecr: Store the SAP password in the OS-backed `SecretStorage` instead of the settings file. Use with the `DNova: Set ABAP ADT MCP Password` command.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.envPath: Absolute path to a `.env` file with SAP connection parameters (SAP_URL, SAP_CLIENT, SAP_USERNAME, SAP_PASSWORD, ...). When set, this takes priority over the URL/username/password settings and is passed to the MCP server via `--env-path`.
dnova-copilot.config.mcp.abapAdt.systemT: SAP system type. Controls which ADT tools are available (e.g. classic Programs require on-premise).
